# Analysis Preparation

---
## Read packages

```{r read packages}
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(ggeffects)
library(summarytools)
library(ggrepel) 
library(lmerTest)
library(effectsize)
library(ggdist)
library(tidyverse)
```


## Source functions

```{r source helper function}
source("recall_helper_functions.R")
```


## Read Encoding & Recall Datasets

```{r read data, echo=FALSE}
# set working directory
path = dirname(rstudioapi::getActiveDocumentContext()$path)
setwd(path)

# read encoding and free recall data
baytour_recall_data_raw <- read_csv("event_baytour_recall.csv")
encoding_data <- read_csv("encoding_data.csv")
```

## Data transformation: recall data

```{r recall data transformation}
# transform data into long format
baytour_recall_data <- baytour_recall_data_raw %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(6:23), values_to = "item_num") %>% 
  select(`Subject ID`, `Tour Section (H/P)`, "item_num") %>%
  mutate(subject_id = `Subject ID`, block = `Tour Section (H/P)`) %>%  
  select(subject_id, block, item_num) %>%
  group_by(subject_id, block) %>%
  mutate(recall_position = row_number()) %>% # original order of items 
  filter(!(block == "P" & recall_position > 13)) %>% # block "P" has 13 recall space
  mutate(block_recode = 
           case_when(block == "H" ~ 1,
                     block == "P" ~ 2)) # recode block to numeric value

View(baytour_recall_data)
```

```{r checking duplicates}
# Check for duplicates within subject and block
duplicates <- baytour_recall_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(item_num)) %>%  # remove NA item_nums first
  group_by(subject_id, block) %>%
  mutate(duplicate = duplicated(item_num) | duplicated(item_num, fromLast = TRUE)) %>%
  filter(duplicate) %>%
  arrange(subject_id, block, item_num)

print(duplicates)
```


## Exclude participants with fewer than 5 order-tagged recall items (4 transitions)

```{r trial exclusion}
# list out the ids 
baytour_exclude_trial <- list()
counter <- 1

# count trials within each block for each participant
for (each_subject in unique(baytour_recall_data$subject_id)) {
  # compute the block number
  max_block = unique(baytour_recall_data$block[baytour_recall_data$subject_id == each_subject])
  # count the item_num in each block within each participant
  for(each_block in max_block) {
    n_items <- sum(!is.na(baytour_recall_data$item_num[baytour_recall_data$subject_id == each_subject & baytour_recall_data$block == each_block]))
    if (n_items < 5) {
      baytour_exclude_trial[[counter]] <- list(subject = each_subject, block = each_block)
      counter <- counter + 1
    }
  # print out how many recall items each subject has
  # print(paste("Subject:", each_subject, "has", n_items, "items"))
  }
}

# Convert each list element into a data frame row and then bind all rows together
exclusion_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(baytour_exclude_trial, function(x) {
  data.frame(subject_id = x$subject, block = x$block, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}))
exclusion_df

# exclude participants
baytour_recall_data_clean <- anti_join(baytour_recall_data, exclusion_df, by = c("subject_id", "block"))
```

## Combine clean recall and encoding

```{r combine datasets}
complete_baytour_data <- recall_binding(encoding_data, baytour_recall_data_clean)
complete_baytour_data  <- complete_baytour_data %>%
  mutate(block_recode = case_when(
    block == "H" ~ 1, 
    block == "P" ~ 2
  ))
```

## Save transformed dataset (optional)

```{r}
# write complete_baytour_data (with event categories)
write.csv(complete_baytour_data, "complete_baytour_data.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```


# Analysis 

## Calculates transition & counts

```{r}
complete_recall_transition <- calculate_transitions(encoding_data, complete_baytour_data)
complete_recall_transition
```

***Note.*** "actual_counts" and "possible_counts" are calculated based on "actual_lags" and "all_possible_lags". "lags" here means transitions from the current item to the next item. 

## Compute overall lag-CRP

```{r compute lag-CRP}
# calculate lag-CRP based on all possible transitions of a recall trial
complete_CRP <- CRP_calculation(complete_recall_transition)
complete_CRP
```

***Note.*** Since most participants only recalled a few items, their actual counts of item transition is 0 for the ones un-recalled. Thus, there are a lot of 0 values in CRP column.

## Event Label: Create event transition label

```{r add event label}
zone_based_data <- zone_based_category(complete_recall_transition)
```

## Lag-CRP

### Same denominator approach: Create within VS. between datasets and calculate lag-CRP for each

```{r create separate event datasets & calculate lag-CRP}
# calculate lag-CRP using a common-denominator approach for each event type
common_deno_result <- common_deno_CRP(zone_based_data)
# combine lag-CRP results from within-event & between-event trials
common_event_CRP_data <- bind_rows(common_deno_result$within, common_deno_result$between)
```

```{r calculate mean lag-CRP scores for within- vs. between-event lags}
# calculate mean lag-CRP scores for each participant, grouped by lags and event transition
lag_CRP_mean_common <- common_event_CRP_data %>%
  group_by(subject_id, lags, event_transition) %>%
  summarise(mean_CRP = mean(CRP, na.rm = TRUE),
                   .groups = "drop") 
lag_CRP_mean_common
```
### Creating positive and negative subsets - Lag-CRP
```{r creating positive and negative subsets}
# exclude participants
dropped_subject <- c("ID22MA", "ID27MA", "ID64MA") # three participants were excluded from analyses because they did not produce both type of transitions within this lag range (e.g., participants who made only within- or between-event recalls)

# filter datasets to contain either 1) postive lags from 0 to 3, OR 2) negative lags from 0 to -3

# positive chunk
lag_CRP_positive_common <- lag_CRP_mean_common %>%
  filter(lags < 4 & lags > 0) %>% # that maximum lag to include that havs both within- & between-event data
  filter(!(subject_id %in% dropped_subject))

# negative chunk
lag_CRP_negative_common <-  lag_CRP_mean_common %>%
  filter(lags < 0 & lags > -4) %>%
  filter(!(subject_id %in% dropped_subject))

```

### Paired-samples t test
```{r positive lags}
# paired samples t test formula
positive_paired_ttest <- lapply(split(lag_CRP_positive_common , lag_CRP_positive_common$lags), run_paired_ttest)
positive_paired_ttest 

# Combine the list into a single data frame
modelSum_pos_pairt <- bind_rows(positive_paired_ttest)

# 3. Apply the bonferroni correction
modelSum_pos_pairt$p_bonferroni <- p.adjust(modelSum_pos_pairt$p_raw, method = "bonferroni")

# 4. View your corrected results
print(modelSum_pos_pairt)
```

```{r}
# paired samples t test formula
negative_paired_ttest <- lapply(split(lag_CRP_negative_common, lag_CRP_negative_common$lags), run_paired_ttest)

# Combine the list into a single data frame
modelSum_neg_pairt <- bind_rows(negative_paired_ttest)

# 3. Apply the bonferroni correction
modelSum_neg_pairt$p_bonferroni <- p.adjust(modelSum_neg_pairt$p_raw, method = "bonferroni")

# 4. View your corrected results
print(modelSum_neg_pairt)
```



### Lag-CRP Curve

```{r lag-CRP curve, include = TRUE, echo=FALSE}
# calculate mean & se lag-CRP for each lag, for two event types, among participants' CRP averages
lagCRP_plotting_common <- lag_CRP_mean_common %>%
  group_by(lags, event_transition) %>%
  summarise(avg_CRP = mean(mean_CRP, na.rm = TRUE), 
            CRP_sd = sd(mean_CRP, na.rm = TRUE),
            CRP_n = n(),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(CRP_se = CRP_sd/sqrt(CRP_n)) %>%
  bind_rows(data.frame(lags=0, avg_CRP = NA, CRP_se = NA))

lag_filtered <- lagCRP_plotting_common %>%
  filter(lags >= -5 & lags <= 5) %>%
  filter(!is.na(event_transition))

# create visualization
Fig3_a <- lag_filtered %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=lags, y = avg_CRP, color = event_transition, fill = event_transition)) +
    
    ## left side: negative
    geom_ribbon(data = subset(lagCRP_plotting_common, lags < 0 & lags >= -5),
              aes(ymin = avg_CRP - CRP_se,
                  ymax = avg_CRP + CRP_se,
                  group = event_transition),
              alpha = .25, colour = NA) +
    geom_line (data = subset(lagCRP_plotting_common, lags < 0 & lags >= -5),
             linewidth = 1) +
    
    ## right side: positive
    geom_ribbon(data = subset(lagCRP_plotting_common, lags > 0 & lags <= 5), 
              aes(ymin = avg_CRP - CRP_se,
                  ymax = avg_CRP + CRP_se,
                  group = event_transition),
              alpha = .25, colour = NA) +
    geom_line (data = subset(lagCRP_plotting_common, lags > 0 & lags <= 5),
             linewidth = 1) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = avg_CRP - CRP_se, ymax = avg_CRP + CRP_se),
                 width = .1, position = position_dodge(0.05)) +
    
    ## adding points with bootstrapped interval
    stat_summary(fun.data=mean_cl_boot, geom="pointrange", size=.6) +
    
  # Unified manual color/fill
    scale_color_manual(
    values = c("between" = "#436B7D", "within" = "#D85757"),
    labels = c("Between", "Within")
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("between" = "#436B7D", "within" = "#D85757"),
    guide   = "none") +      
    guides(colour = guide_legend(title = NULL)) +  # only one legend
    
  # add significance annotations
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = c(-1, 1, 2, 3),
      y = c(0.145, 0.335, 0.185, 0.095),
      label = c("***", "***", "***", "***"),
      size = 5
    ) +
  
    ## Axis and theme improvements
    theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
    theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
  ) +
    labs(x = "Lag", y = "Conditional Response Probability",
       color = "Event transition type") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = -5:5)

Fig3_a

# Save as a 6‑inch‑by‑6‑inch square, high‑resolution
ggsave("Fig3_a.png", Fig3_a, width = 8, height = 6, units = "in", dpi = 600)
```
## Temporal Cluster

### Temporal Cluster Calculation - Common-denominator Approach

```{r temporal clusters, include = TRUE, echo=FALSE}
# calculate percentile rank for each recall trial
common_deno_recall_ptile <- zone_based_data %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    abs_possible_lags       = list(abs(as.numeric(unlist(possible_lags)))), #includes all possible lags as the denominator
    abs_actual_lags_within  = if_else(event_transition == "within",
                                      abs(actual_lags), NA_real_),
    abs_actual_lags_between = if_else(event_transition == "between",
                                      abs(actual_lags), NA_real_),
    # list column that holds the two percentile ranks
    ptile = list(
      common_temp_percentile_rank(
        abs_actual_lags_within,
        abs_actual_lags_between,
        abs_possible_lags
      )
    )
  ) %>%                                   # ── everything above is still row-wise
  hoist(ptile,                            # ── pull the two elements out
        ptile_rank_within  = "ptile_rank_within",
        ptile_rank_between = "ptile_rank_between") %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r proportion check}
# check whether it's proportionally balanced for between-event items vs. within-event items
sum(!is.na(common_deno_recall_ptile$ptile_rank_within))
sum(!is.na(common_deno_recall_ptile$ptile_rank_between))
```

```{r within-event temporal factor summary}
# create a within-event ptile sheet
within_deno_recall_ptile <- common_deno_recall_ptile %>%
  filter(event_transition == "within") %>%
  filter(!is.na(ptile_rank_within)) %>%
  filter(abs_actual_lags_within <= 3) # control for temporal distance - match for maximum within-event items

# group by subject and block and calculate temp factor
tempscore_subject_within <- within_deno_recall_ptile %>%
  dplyr::group_by(subject_id, block) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(temporal_factor = sum(ptile_rank_within) / n(),
                   .groups = "drop") 

# calculate the mean temporal factor scores for each participant across blocks
tempscore_subject_within_mean <- tempscore_subject_within %>%
  group_by(subject_id) %>%
  summarize(mean_tempfactor = mean(temporal_factor),
            .groups = "drop") 

# calculate the overall mean temporal factor scores for within-event transitions
tempscore_within_mean <- mean(tempscore_subject_within_mean$mean_tempfactor)
tempscore_within_sd <- sd(tempscore_subject_within_mean$mean_tempfactor)
```

```{r between-event temporal factor summary}
# create a between-event ptile sheet
between_deno_recall_ptile <- common_deno_recall_ptile %>%
  filter(event_transition == "between") %>%
  filter(!is.na(ptile_rank_between)) %>%
  filter(abs_actual_lags_between <= 3) # control for temporal distance - match for maximum within-event items

# group by subject and block and calculate temp factor
tempscore_subject_between <- between_deno_recall_ptile %>% 
  dplyr::group_by(subject_id, block) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(temporal_factor = sum(ptile_rank_between) / n(),
                   .groups = "drop")

# calculate the mean temporal factor scores for each participant across blocks
tempscore_subject_between_mean <- tempscore_subject_between %>%
  group_by(subject_id) %>%
  summarize(mean_tempfactor = mean(temporal_factor),
            .groups = "drop") 

# calculate the overall mean temporal factor scores for within-event transitions
tempscore_between_mean <- mean(tempscore_subject_between_mean$mean_tempfactor)
tempscore_between_sd <- sd(tempscore_subject_between_mean $mean_tempfactor)
```

```{r check proportion after restricting temporal distance}
# check whether it's proportionally balanced for between-event items vs. within-event items
sum(!is.na(within_deno_recall_ptile$ptile_rank_within))
sum(!is.na(between_deno_recall_ptile$ptile_rank_between))

# check the proportions for lag 1, 2, and 3
within_deno_recall_ptile %>%
  filter(!is.na(ptile_rank_within)) %>%
  count(abs_actual_lags_within)
between_deno_recall_ptile %>%
  filter(!is.na(ptile_rank_between)) %>%
  count(abs_actual_lags_between)
```

```{r temporal factor output}
# print outputs - within-events
cat("Average within-event temporal cluster score:", tempscore_within_mean, "\n",
    "SD for within-event temporal factor score:", tempscore_within_sd, "\n")

# print outputs - between events
cat("Average between-event temporal cluster score:", tempscore_between_mean, "\n",
    "SD for between-event temporal factor score:", tempscore_between_sd, "\n")
```

### Combine both within- and between-event datasets for analysis

```{r combine between & within event temporal scores}
# combine two datasheets, organized by block and subject
tempscore_subject_between_mutate <- tempscore_subject_between %>%
  mutate(event_transition = "between")
tempscore_subject_within_mutate <- tempscore_subject_within %>%
  mutate(event_transition = "within")
tempscore_subject_combined <- bind_rows(tempscore_subject_between_mutate, tempscore_subject_within_mutate)

# combined over subjects
tempscore_combined <- tempscore_subject_combined %>%
  group_by(subject_id, event_transition) %>%
  summarize(mean_temp = mean(temporal_factor),
            .groups = "drop")
```

```{r participant exclusion based on one-type of event transition}
# Check which participants have both 'within' and 'between'
participants_check <- tempscore_combined %>%
  group_by(subject_id) %>%
  summarize(n_conditions = n_distinct(event_transition)) %>%
  filter(n_conditions < 2)
participants_check 

# exclude subjects with only one type of event transition (either within- or between-)
tempscore_combined <- tempscore_combined %>%
   filter(!subject_id %in% participants_check$subject_id)
```


### T-test Analysis

```{r paired sample t test: temporal cluster scores}
# Pivot the data to wide format
tempscore_wide <- tempscore_combined %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = event_transition, values_from = mean_temp)

# First check whether the temporal factor for both groups are significantly higher than the null
# One sample t test with two tails for both event types
t.test(tempscore_wide$within, mu = 0.5)
t.test(tempscore_wide$between, mu = 0.5)
```

```{r paired-samples t test}
# Paired t-test comparing within- and between-event temp factor
temp_event_t <- t.test(tempscore_wide$within, tempscore_wide$between, paired = TRUE)
temp_event_t

# Cohen's d
repeated_measures_d(tempscore_wide$within, tempscore_wide$between, method = "z")
```

### Visualization
```{r temporal cluster score graph}
Fig3_b <- ggplot(tempscore_combined, aes(x = mean_temp,
                    y = event_transition,
                    colour =  event_transition,
```

## Forward Asymmetry

### Forward asymmetry calculation

```{r calculate forward asymmetry}
forward_asymmetry_event <- zone_based_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(actual_lags)) %>%
  mutate(fwd_bwd = ifelse(actual_lags > 0, 1, -1))
```

```{r within-event forward asymmetry}

# count all forward transitions & calculate proportion scores for within
fwd_asymmetry_within_subject <- forward_asymmetry_event  %>%
  dplyr::group_by(subject_id, block) %>%
  summarise(
    all_count = n(),
    fwd_count_within = sum(event_transition == "within" & fwd_bwd == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    fwd_asymmetry = fwd_count_within / all_count,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# summary based on individual 
fwd_asymmetry_within_summary <- fwd_asymmetry_within_subject %>%
  group_by(subject_id) %>%
  summarise(fwd_asymmetry_mean = mean(fwd_asymmetry),
            .groups = "drop")

# calculate forward asymmetry means and sds
foward_asym_within_mean <- mean(fwd_asymmetry_within_summary$fwd_asymmetry_mean)
foward_asym_within_sd <- sd(fwd_asymmetry_within_summary$fwd_asymmetry_mean)
```

```{r between-event forward asymmetry}
# count all forward transitions & calculate proportion scores for between
fwd_asymmetry_between_subject <- forward_asymmetry_event  %>%
  dplyr::group_by(subject_id, block) %>%
  summarise(
    all_count = n(),
    fwd_count_between = sum(event_transition == "between" & fwd_bwd == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    fwd_asymmetry = fwd_count_between / all_count,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# summary based on individual 
fwd_asymmetry_between_summary <- fwd_asymmetry_between_subject %>%
  group_by(subject_id) %>%
  summarise(fwd_asymmetry_mean = mean(fwd_asymmetry),
            .groups = "drop")

# calculate forward asymmetry means and sds
foward_asym_between_mean <- mean(fwd_asymmetry_between_summary$fwd_asymmetry_mean)
foward_asym_between_sd <- sd(fwd_asymmetry_between_summary$fwd_asymmetry_mean)
```

```{r forward asymmetry output}
# print output - within-events
cat("within-event forward asymemtry mean: ", foward_asym_within_mean , "\n")
cat("within-event forward asymemtry sd: ", foward_asym_within_sd, "\n")

# print output - between-events
cat("between-event forward asymemtry mean: ", foward_asym_between_mean , "\n")
cat("between-event forward asymemtry sd: ", foward_asym_between_sd, "\n")
```
### Combine both within- and between-event datasets for analysis

```{r combine between & within forward asymmetry datasets}
# combine two datasheets
fwd_asymmetry_between_subject_mutate <- fwd_asymmetry_between_subject %>%
  mutate(event_transition = "between")
fwd_asymmetry_withinsubject_mutate <- fwd_asymmetry_within_subject %>%
  mutate(event_transition = "within")
fwd_asymmetry_combined <- bind_rows(fwd_asymmetry_between_subject_mutate, fwd_asymmetry_withinsubject_mutate)

# combined over subjects
fwd_combined <- fwd_asymmetry_combined %>%
  group_by(subject_id, event_transition) %>%
  summarize(mean_fwd = mean(fwd_asymmetry),
            .groups = "drop")
```

```{r participant exclusion based on having only one type of event}
# Check which participants have both 'within' and 'between'
participants_check_fwd <- fwd_combined %>%
  group_by(subject_id) %>%
  summarize(n_conditions = n_distinct(event_transition)) %>%
  filter(n_conditions < 2)
participants_check_fwd

# exclude subjects with only one type of event transition
fwd_combined <- fwd_combined %>%
   filter(!subject_id %in% participants_check_fwd$subject_id)
```

### T-test analysis

```{r one-sample t test: forward asymmetry}
# Pivot the data to wide format
fwd_wide <- fwd_combined %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = event_transition, values_from = mean_fwd)

# Check if forward asymmetry is higher than the null
# Because we split the numerators, the expected average is now 0.25
# One sample t test with two tails for both event types
t.test(fwd_wide$within, mu = 0.25)
t.test(fwd_wide$between, mu = 0.25)
```

```{r paired-samples t test}
# Paired t-test comparing within- and between-event forward asymmetry
fwd_event_t <- t.test(fwd_wide$within, fwd_wide$between, paired = TRUE)
fwd_event_t

# Cohen's d
repeated_measures_d(fwd_wide$within, fwd_wide$between, method = "z")
```
